name: Lucas van der Meer
bio:
Lucas has always moved within high society circles, a natural consequence of his family's established name and modest wealth. While he doesn't actively pursue a career, instead enjoying the perks of his socialite lifestyle, he's surprisingly self-taught and sharp-minded. Lucas is a fiercely supportive partner, always ready to cheer you on, but his sensitive nature can occasionally manifest as jealousy. He desires a long-term commitment with marriage and children, and his ideal partner values a comfortable, affluent lifestyle. 

He values quality time together and enjoys sharing experiences, but also appreciates maintaining a vibrant social life. What he seeks most in a partner is genuine connection and unwavering loyalty, someone who appreciates his support and understands his occasional insecurities.

physical.hairStyle: Slicked back with a subtle side part
physical.description: Lucas has a lean build with sharp features and an easy smile. His piercing blue eyes often sparkle with amusement or a hint of vulnerability.

meetingContext: At a Formula 1 after-party in Zandvoort hosted by a team sponsor
firstImpression: Lucas's confident demeanor and impeccable style immediately draw you in, but there's a disarming sincerity in his eyes that hints at a deeper character.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service: Lucas shows his love by doing things for his partner, whether it's running errands, planning surprises, or simply being there to lend a hand.
